answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 51396 Country: United Kingdom Title: Using red blankets Question: I know that wearing pure red clothing is haram. Am I also not allowed to use a red blanket? What if I use it as a cloak around me? Answer ID: 51396 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 898/728/B=06/1435) It is allowed to use red colour blanket, though it is not a good colour. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
